gt911_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the touchscreen.

*See also: [gt911 Touch Screen Controller](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/gt911#configuration-variables)*

index.docs:
**int**: Internal index of the touch button, between 0 and 3. The default is 0.

*See also: [gt911 Touch Screen Controller](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/gt911#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually set the ID of this touchscreen.

*See also: [gt911 Touch Screen Controller](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/gt911#configuration-variables)*

interrupt_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The touch detection pin if run to an on-MCU pin.

*See also: [gt911 Touch Screen Controller](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/gt911#configuration-variables)*

reset_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The reset pin.

*See also: [gt911 Touch Screen Controller](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/gt911#configuration-variables)*
